cardTypeDescription.survivor: Survivor cards represent player characters with abilities and equipment slots.
cardTypeDescription.equipment: Equipment cards are items that survivors can equip and use.
cardTypeDescription.pimpWeapon: Pimp Weapon cards are powerful unique weapons with special abilities.
cardTypeDescription.zombieSpawn: Zombie Spawn cards determine which zombies appear during the game.
cardTypeDescription.abomination: Abomination cards are powerful boss zombies with high health and special abilities.

plusOneAction.name: +1 Action
plusOneAction.description: The Survivor may perform 1 additional Action during their activation.

plusOneFreeMove.name: +1 Free Move
plusOneFreeMove.description: Once per activation, the Survivor may perform 1 Move Action for free (it does not cost an Action).

plusOneFreeSearch.name: +1 Free Search
plusOneFreeSearch.description: Once per activation, the Survivor may perform 1 Search Action for free (it does not cost an Action).

plusOneDieMelee.name: +1 Die Melee
plusOneDieMelee.description: The Survivor rolls 1 additional die on all Melee attacks.

plusOneDieRanged.name: +1 Die Ranged
plusOneDieRanged.description: The Survivor rolls 1 additional die on all Ranged attacks.

plusOneDieResultMelee.name: +1 to die result: Melee
plusOneDieResultMelee.description: Add +1 to each die result when making a Melee attack (maximum result of 6).

plusOneDieResultRanged.name: +1 to die result: Ranged
plusOneDieResultRanged.description: Add +1 to each die result when making a Ranged attack (maximum result of 6).

athletic.name: Athletic
athletic.description: The Survivor's Move value is increased by 1.

bloodlustMelee.name: Bloodlust: Melee
bloodlustMelee.description: Each time the Survivor kills a Zombie with a Melee attack, they may immediately make 1 free Melee attack.

bornLeader.name: Born Leader
bornLeader.description: Once per activation, the Survivor may give 1 Action to another Survivor in the same Zone.

bulletproof.name: Bulletproof
bulletproof.description: The Survivor ignores 1 Wound from Ranged attacks each time they are targeted.

combatTraining.name: Combat Training
combatTraining.description: The Survivor rolls 2 additional dice on all Combat attacks.

crossbowExpert.name: Crossbow Expert
crossbowExpert.description: Crossbow weapons wielded by this Survivor do not generate Noise.

duckAndCover.name: Duck and Cover
duckAndCover.description: The Survivor may spend 1 Action to ignore all Wounds from 1 attack until their next activation.

eagleEyes.name: Eagle Eyes
eagleEyes.description: All Ranged weapons wielded by the Survivor gain +1 to their Range.

fast.name: Fast
fast.description: The Survivor's Move value is increased by 1.

firefighter.name: Firefighter
firefighter.description: The Survivor is immune to Fire damage.

fortunate.name: Fortunate
fortunate.description: Once per round, the Survivor may reroll 1 die of their choice.

freeSlotAny.name: Free Slot: Any
freeSlotAny.description: The Survivor gains 1 additional equipment slot that can hold any type of equipment.

freeSlotHand.name: Free Slot: Hand
freeSlotHand.description: The Survivor gains 1 additional Hand equipment slot.

freeSlotShoulder.name: Free Slot: Shoulder
freeSlotShoulder.description: The Survivor gains 1 additional Shoulder equipment slot.

gunslinger.name: Gunslinger
gunslinger.description: The Survivor may make Ranged attacks as part of a Move Action without any penalty.

hoarder.name: Hoarder
hoarder.description: The Survivor may carry 1 additional item in their reserve slots.

ironFist.name: Iron Fist
ironFist.description: The Survivor's Unarmed attacks roll 1 additional die and hit on a result of 3+.

jumpShot.name: Jump Shot
jumpShot.description: The Survivor may make Ranged attacks during a Move Action without spending an additional Action.

loud.name: Loud
loud.description: All Zombies in the Survivor's Zone are automatically activated and target the Survivor.

makeshiftWeapon.name: Makeshift Weapon
makeshiftWeapon.description: The Survivor may use Improvised Weapons without any penalty.

moveAndShoot.name: Move and Shoot
moveAndShoot.description: The Survivor may move up to their full Move value and then make 1 Ranged attack as a single Action.

ninja.name: Ninja
ninja.description: The Survivor's actions do not generate any Noise.

painkiller.name: Painkiller
painkiller.description: The Survivor ignores the first Wound they receive each round.

rebelYell.name: Rebel Yell
rebelYell.description: When the Survivor takes a Wound, each Survivor in the same Zone gains +1 die on all attacks until the end of the round.

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.description: The Survivor heals 1 Wound at the end of each round.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.description: The Survivor finds 1 additional item whenever they perform a Search Action.

slippery.name: Slippery
slippery.description: The Survivor may move through Zombie-occupied Zones without stopping.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.description: The Survivor's Ranged attacks ignore Cover and can target Zones up to 1 Zone further than the weapon's normal Range.

sprint.name: Sprint
sprint.description: The Survivor may move up to 3 Zones when spending 1 Move Action, regardless of their normal Move value.

steadyHand.name: Steady Hand
steadyHand.description: The Survivor may reroll up to 1 missed die per Ranged attack.

stoic.name: Stoic
stoic.description: The Survivor is immune to Panic.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.description: The Survivor may spend 1 Action to force all Zombies in their Zone to target only them until the end of the round.

tough.name: Tough
tough.description: The Survivor's maximum Wound capacity is increased by 1.

train.name: Train
train.description: The Survivor may spend 1 Action to allow another Survivor in the same Zone to use 1 Skill.

trickShot.name: Trick Shot
trickShot.description: The Survivor's Ranged attacks can hit targets in adjacent Zones without the normal range penalty.

zombieLink.name: Zombie Link
zombieLink.description: Zombies ignore the Survivor unless the Survivor attacks them or enters their Zone.

holiday.title: Holiday Survivor
holiday.description: Holiday Survivors bring festive spirit to the darkest times. Armed with seasonal gear and holiday traditions turned weapons, they celebrate survival with a smile.

kids.title: Kid Survivor
kids.description: Kid Survivors are young heroes who outwit zombies with quick thinking and small size. Underestimated by many, they surprise everyone with their resilience and resourcefulness.

park.title: Park Survivor
park.description: Park Survivors were caught in the outbreak while enjoying the outdoors. Their knowledge of open spaces and physical fitness gives them an edge in navigating dangerous terrain.

police.title: Police Survivor
police.description: Police Survivors apply their combat training and crisis management experience to the zombie apocalypse. They are disciplined fighters who protect the group.

supes.title: Super Survivor
supes.description: Super Survivors possess extraordinary powers that set them apart from ordinary people. Their abilities go beyond normal human limitations, making them invaluable in the fight against the undead.

zombvivor.title: Zombivor
zombvivor.description: Zombivors are survivors who have been infected but not fully turned. They gain undead resilience — able to absorb more damage — while battling their darker instincts to remain on the side of the living.
